headline: Sensex gains 400 points and Nifty crosses 23,450 amid easing crude prices and positive global cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing crude oil prices provided significant relief to the domestic market
Positive global cues from Asian markets supported the opening gains
Strong buying interest in heavyweights like Kotak Mahindra Bank and Bajaj Finance
Nifty 50 successfully reclaimed and traded above the 23,450 level
whatHappening: Airtel Money announced its intention to launch an IPO on the London Stock Exchange
IndiGo reported a dominant 65% domestic aviation market share for the month of August
Elecon Engineering shares surged 12% following a strong six-month performance trend
The Bombay High Court rejected an Adani Group plea regarding the legal status of duty-free shops
summary: Indian markets rebounded on Wednesday with the Sensex rising 400 points and Nifty crossing 23,450, supported by lower crude prices and positive global sentiment. Corporate highlights include Airtel Money's London IPO plans and IndiGo's continued dominance in the aviation sector. Elecon Engineering and banking majors like Kotak Mahindra saw significant buying interest.
